node.statement: For each admissible approximate-unitary base V, the coordinate polar map p_V constructed in node 1.2 is quantitatively one-to-one and locally C^1 invertible, and when the defect of V is below delta by the stated C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2) margin it has a unique zero with Hermitian polar displacement of norm <delta.
